points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven workspace steady packages passed structural validation; Re200 completed=false and is correctly rejected. M015 inviscid converged status contradicts its changing trajectory.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior official read-only validation passed seven steady packages and rejected honestly failed Re200; structural success is not numerical convergence evidence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 inviscid workspace metadata reports completed/converged at step2500 and residual reduction0.630631 orders. Selected root launch call_0e630484a01143669e0ccd24 at 2026-08-15T06:23:25.620Z (arguments SHA256 41a6bf0fa351694946aaf41e18f6fbdb37cfbf41710ee2157eb0b1c79262603f) sets the canonical case max-steps to 2500; workspace metadata start 06:23:27 and 14db231d manifest match. Final1000 Cd 0.477107→0.432620 and Cl −0.00478578..0.00945677; final500 Cd 0.454068→0.432631, so the force trajectory is not a justified plateau. Recorded revision 937f09c uses a 500-row 5% Cd-only plateau, ignoring Cl; exact binary is unbound. Separately Re200 is honestly failed, not the basis for DQ7.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M015 inviscid Cd falls0.477107→0.432620 over final1000; Re20 Cd7.114 and M015 laminar Cd2.287 remain high; Re200 has no sustained oscillation.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Historical 14db231d checkpoint includes eight force/residual/Mach sets. Several full-domain contours obscure body and startup compresses late force; Re200 has no readable late lift and drag.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly labels failed Re200 and discloses controls/drag limitations, but M015 inviscid convergence claim is unsupported and fixed limiter cap weakens formal second-order claim.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: 14db231d manifest and root session link workspace results; figures have historical hashes, but runtime binary and exact plot inputs remain unbound. Re200 wake manifest mistakenly names forces.csv as source; plotting code reads field_final.vtu.
